notes.title: Patch 1.1 is live
notes.content:
First off I'd like to thank everyone for playing, and while also being patient while we fix issues. I'm a solo dev with a family, if you haven't realized already :) and the holidays were really busy.

The follow bugs were fixed.
- shops building as the bakeshop and/or other shops
- mail is now being sent per day rather than per week. Sending per week caused too much mail to come thus making the upgrades to the post office pointless
- Upgrade images now display correct images
- Mouse disappearing when starting the game.
- Shop positions not saving
- Game keeps playing in the background once you lose

Thank you all for your patience and I wish you all a very happy 2025.
